project_type: TypeScript Express backend + React/Vite frontend, deployed separately (backend on Render, frontend on Vercel)
build_system: npm with TypeScript compiler (tsc). Backend: npm run build compiles to dist/. Frontend: separate Vite build.
test_framework: None found in backend. No test/ or __tests__/ directories. No jest, mocha, vitest in package.json.
build_command: npm run build (runs: npm run clean && tsc)
verification_instructions:
1. Build the backend: npm run build
2. Check that dist/ is created successfully
3. Deploy to Render and verify cookies are set with correct sameSite and secure flags using browser DevTools > Application > Cookies
4. Test login flow on live site: login at https://ticket-hive-main.vercel.app/login, then navigate to a movie details page and verify no redirect to login occurs
5. Check Network tab to confirm cookies are being sent with API requests
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory containing compiled JavaScript. Generated by: npm run build. Not checked into git (in .gitignore).
environment_constraints: Backend deployed on Render with limited memory (460MB based on --max-old-space-size flag in start script). Frontend and backend are on different domains (vercel.app vs onrender.com), requiring cross-origin cookie configuration.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Standard practices apply: test changes, avoid breaking existing functionality, update .env documentation if needed.
key_patterns:
1. JWT tokens stored in httpOnly cookies (accessToken: 15min, refreshToken: 7 days)
2. AuthMiddleware checks cookies, refreshes access token using refresh token if expired
3. Token generation in Utils/GenerateToken.ts using TokenService class
4. CORS configured in server.ts with allowedOrigins array
5. Frontend uses RTK Query (ApiSlice) with credentials: 'include' for cookie-based auth
6. Frontend stores user info (id, name, email) in localStorage, NOT tokens
7. PrivateRoute component checks localStorage userInfo and makes API calls to verify auth
8. Three separate auth systems: user (JWT_SECRET), admin (JWT_SECRET_ADMIN), theater (JWT_SECRET_THEATER)
directory_structure: Backend: Back-End/, Config/, Controllers/, Middlewares/, Models/, Repositories/, Routes/, Services/, Utils/, dist/ (compiled), public/ (static assets). Frontend: src/ with Components/, Core/, features/, Routes/, Store/ (Redux).
